title: Console: one-click rollback flow w/ async progress + Slack/on-call notifications
author: Hannah Rivera
release_notes: Console: Added one-click rollback flow for Optimize config versions with async status/progress tracking and notifications to Slack/on-call channels (feature-flagged).
body: Title: Console: one-click rollback flow w/ async progress + Slack/on-call notifications Context This PR wires the Console rollback UX to the rollback API (from PR #10457) and adds async progress tracking + notification hooks so on-call can execute and monitor rollbacks quickly. This is part of the Safe apply + rollback mechanism effort (ENG-4826). Primary goals: 1) Make rollback a single action from the version history UI (with confirmation + blast radius info). 2) Treat rollback as an async job with status polling + timeouts so the Console doesn’t block on propagation. 3) Post structured notifications to Slack (incident/on-call channels) with deep links back to the rollback job and relevant audit event IDs. 4) Preserve RBAC semantics (optimize.config.rollback) and record justification text for audit trails. Scope / user-visible changes - Adds “Rollback to this version” action to the version compare panel (Console Backend-driven view). - Adds a rollback confirmation modal that requires a reason (free-text) and shows computed blast radius (scope: customer/region/cluster/route/model) and target version metadata. - Starts rollback as an async operation, surfaces progress in the UI (queued -> running -> propagated -> verified|failed) and includes a “Copy correlation ID” affordance for on-call. - Posts notifications for rollback_started, rollback_succeeded, rollback_failed to Slack via internal notification hooks with consistent payload shape (threaded by rollback_job_id). Implementation details - API integration: calls POST /v1/optimize/config/rollback with idempotency key; stores returned rollback_job_id and starts polling GET /v1/optimize/config/rollbacks/{id}. - Async model: Console backend introduces a RollbackTracker that wraps the job polling, emits internal events, and supports exponential backoff. UI polls via Console backend to avoid exposing internal endpoints to browsers. - Notifications: adds a notification emitter (console-notify) that publishes to internal hooks (deploy-bot / incident-bot bridge) with channel routing based on environment and tenant tier. Prod notifications default to #eng-oncall and #incidents for enterprise tenants; staging goes to #console-dev. - Audit linkage: extracts audit_event_id from rollback job terminal states and includes it in Slack payload + UI “View audit entry” link. - Guardrails: requires rollback justification unless operator has break_glass permission; break glass path still logs justification as “break-glass: <reason>”. - Feature flags: gated behind optimizeRollbackUi + optimizeRollbackNotifications. Flags are enabled for internal tenants only by default. - Metrics: emits console.rollback.start/success/failure counters and console.rollback.duration_ms histogram with tags: env, tenant_tier, scope_type, result. Files / areas changed (high level) - console/backend/optimize/rollback_controller.ts (new endpoints for UI) - console/backend/optimize/rollback_tracker.ts (async poller + state machine) - console/backend/notifications/optimize_rollback_notifier.ts (Slack payload + routing) - console/web/src/pages/Optimize/ConfigHistory/VersionCompare.tsx (Rollback CTA) - console/web/src/components/Optimize/RollbackConfirmModal.tsx (new) - console/web/src/components/AsyncJob/JobStatusPill.tsx (reused + small enhancements) - shared/feature_flags/flags.ts (new flags) - shared/metrics/console_metrics.ts (new metrics) - docs/internal/runbooks/links.ts (deep link helpers) Example Slack payload (sanitized) event=optimize_config.rollback_started rollback_job_id=rbk_01HR8V… tenant=helixbank-prod scope=customer:10482 region=us-east-1 target_version=v17 actor=hannah.rivera reason="Mitigate p95 latency spike post v18" link=https://console.redwood.ai/optimize/config/history?scope=…&job=rbk_… Checklist - [x] RBAC enforced (optimize.config.rollback) - [x] Idempotency key wired (Console uses X-Idempotency-Key header) - [x] Async job tracking + timeout behavior tested - [x] Slack notifications behind flag - [x] Dashboard links and correlation IDs included - [x] Unit tests for tracker state transitions - [x] Integration test for rollback start + terminal success/failure paths Testing - Local: pnpm test console-web; bazel test //console/backend/... - Staging: verified in hosted-sandbox against canary control plane; posted to #console-dev with correct threading; terminal success links to audit entry. - Failure simulation: forced propagation failure via dev knob (simulate_partial_propagation=true) confirms UI marks job failed and Slack posts rollback_failed with remediation hint + runbook link. Known limitations / follow-ups - UI currently shows whole-config rollback only (per ADR); partial rollback remains out of scope. - Post-rollback “verify” stage uses propagation completion + basic health signals (no quality/evals gating yet). - Slack routing rules for Dedicated tenants are simplistic (uses tenant tier + env); follow-up to route to per-customer shared channels when configured. Related - ENG-4826 Console UI one-click rollback flow - ENG-4823 Rollback endpoint semantics + idempotency - ENG-4828 Metrics and alerts for config changes - Incident motivation: SUP-2418
commits: console/backend: add rollback controller endpoints + job polling wrapper
console/web: add rollback confirm modal + version compare CTA
notifications: emit optimize rollback Slack events w/ deep links
metrics: add rollback counters + duration histogram
tests: tracker state machine unit tests + integration smoke test
review_conversation: Dylan Brooks: Please make sure the UI does not hit control-plane rollback endpoints directly from the browser. We need the backend proxy for auth + audit reasons.

Hannah Rivera (author): Agreed. Updated to route through console backend (/console/api/optimize/rollback/*) and removed direct fetches from the web app. Added a regression test to fail if the web bundle references /v1/optimize/config/rollback.

Chloe Martin: The tracker state machine looks good, but can we bound polling so we don’t DDoS ourselves during an incident? Also please add jitter to avoid thundering herd when multiple operators open the same page.
Hannah Rivera (author): Added max_poll_rate=1s, exponential backoff up to 15s, and +/-20% jitter. Also added an in-memory per-job shared poller so multiple browser sessions share results per node.

Devon Price: Slack payload schema: can you include correlation_id and audit_event_id consistently on both success and failure? Also please thread events by rollback_job_id so on-call gets a single thread.
Hannah Rivera (author): Done. Notifier now threads by rollback_job_id and includes correlation_id always; audit_event_id added on terminal states. Included a runbook link on failure.
Rafael Mendes: Copy needs to be very explicit that rollback affects the whole scope and may invalidate KV cache. Can we add a warning line + link to runbook?
Hannah Rivera (author): Updated modal copy to call out whole-config rollback + potential cache invalidation / warmup. Added link to internal runbook (docs/internal/runbooks/rollback-optimize-config).
Allison Grant: Metrics tags: avoid high-cardinality fields like customer_id. Scope_type is okay, tenant_tier okay. Please remove route/model names from tags.
Hannah Rivera (author): Removed customer_id/route/model from metric tags; only env, tenant_tier, scope_type, result remain. Correlation IDs stay in logs/audit only.
Dylan Brooks: Looks ready once you flip notification flag default-off for prod.
Hannah Rivera (author): Set optimizeRollbackNotifications default false in prod; enabled only for internal tenants via config allowlist.
post_merge_notes: Rollout plan: enable optimizeRollbackUi for internal tenants immediately; enable optimizeRollbackNotifications for internal after 24h if no issues; coordinate with SRE (Rafael/Sean) before enabling for Hosted enterprise tenants.
